summary: 42-year-old Denver man Jason McKain fishing Boulder Creek swept downstream and under a bridge; hiker called dispatch ~4:30 p.m. Sunday after seeing him in fishing waders; vehicle at Boulder Canyon/Sugarloaf Road; creek running 570 cfs, too fast for divers, search shifted to recovery; body located ~1:20 p.m. Monday by search dog Scout near Dome Rock; technical rope recovery
location: Boulder Creek near Dome Rock, Boulder Canyon
responding_agency: Fourmile Fire Protection District, Boulder Emergency Squad, Longmont Emergency Unit, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Boulder County SAR
notes: Mountain-Ear (Barbara Lawlor): incident Sunday June 14, 2015 (body found Monday June 15); crews called off 9 p.m. Sunday due to darkness/high water; dogs brought in Monday morning; separate flipped-kayak reports the same day all accounted for (no second victim)
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Boulder County, Colorado, United States)
